dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave curvature along the trailing edge, forming a smooth parabolic spline from the apex to the posterior basal notch.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a wide pixel radius, categorized as a morphological obtuse shape.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin incline of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width to vertical height ratio of approximately 1.4:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex melon with a large arc radius forming a broad, rounded forehead profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Extremely short and thick rostrum with a low length-to-depth ratio extending from the melon base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse interior angle where the melon curvature terminates and the rostrum begins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single prominent horizontal white linear mark on the right mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniform luminescent cyan-teal coloration across the entire body surface with high-intensity light-scattering and lack of biological countershading.
